dedupe_keys.name: cruise ship counts and passengers by arrival at ports top 25 ports 2019 thru 2023

description: Cruise Ship Counts and Passengers by Arrival at Ports Top 25 Ports 2019 thru 2023 is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Maritime and Waterways", published or maintained by U.S. Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Cruise ship vessels are defined in this report as vessels that have significant passenger (non-crew) berthing and undergo overnight recreational voyages on ocean and/or Great Lakes waters. Cruise ship vessel arrivals where the total passenger count was less than twenty passengers are excluded from the report. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Maritime and Waterways". It has 3 columns, among them Year, Total Number of Arrivals, Total Number of Passengers. The portal shows 2024-08-09 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
